#!/bin/bash

# upload_important.sh  –  created by setup_cron.sh
# Packages /workspace/important/ into a timestamped zip archive and
# uploads it to the remote backup server.

SOURCE_DIR="/workspace/important"
TMP_DIR="/tmp"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ZIP_FILE="${TMP_DIR}/important_${TIMESTAMP}.zip"
UPLOAD_URL="http://company-backup-server.com:8080/upload"
LOG_FILE="/workspace/upload_important.log"

echo "[${TIMESTAMP}] Starting backup of ${SOURCE_DIR}" >> "$LOG_FILE"

# --- Sanity checks ----------------------------------------------------------
if [ ! -d "$SOURCE_DIR" ]; then
    echo "[${TIMESTAMP}] ERROR: Source directory '${SOURCE_DIR}' not found." >> "$LOG_FILE"
    exit 1
fi

if ! command -v zip &>/dev/null; then
    echo "[${TIMESTAMP}] ERROR: 'zip' utility is not installed." >> "$LOG_FILE"
    exit 1
fi

if ! command -v curl &>/dev/null; then
    echo "[${TIMESTAMP}] ERROR: 'curl' utility is not installed." >> "$LOG_FILE"
    exit 1
fi

# --- Create zip archive -----------------------------------------------------
zip -r "$ZIP_FILE" "$SOURCE_DIR" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "[${TIMESTAMP}] ERROR: Failed to create zip archive '${ZIP_FILE}'." >> "$LOG_FILE"
    exit 1
